description: Declarative classification rules for East Sussex County Council quarterly XLSX spending files (Apr 2022 onwards). Default is procurement_paid. REDACTED variants and 'PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL' bucket to direct_payment_individual. Pension Fund transfers bucket to internal_transfer. NHS pass-throughs (Sussex ICB / partnership trusts) and district-council DFG/concessionary travel transfers bucket to statutory_pass_through.

match.supplier_regex: ^(\[REDACTED\]|REDACT(ED)?([ \-,].*)?|NAME WITHHELD|PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL|PAYMENT TO INDIVIDUAL|PRIVATE INDIVIDUAL|INDIVIDUAL)$

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions covering ASC direct payments, foster carer / SGO allowances, CYP direct payments. Lawfully unnamed — not third-party procurement.
East Sussex Pension Fund — LGPS scheme administered by ESCC itself. Money moving inside the council group, not external procurement.

match.supplier_regex: ^(EASTBOURNE BOROUGH COUNCIL|HASTINGS BOROUGH COUNCIL|LEWES DISTRICT COUNCIL|ROTHER DISTRICT COUNCIL|WEALDEN DISTRICT COUNCIL)$

rules.reason: County→district pass-throughs (DFG / concessionary travel / BCF). ESCC has no procurement discretion over these flows.

match.supplier_regex: ^(NHS SUSSEX ICB|EAST SUSSEX HEALTHCARE NHS TRUST|SUSSEX PARTNERSHIP NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS SUSSEX NHS FOUNDATION TRUST)$

rules.reason: BCF s.75 pooled budget transfers to NHS commissioning bodies + trust reimbursements for jointly-commissioned services (Section 75 NHS Act 2006). Legally ring-fenced.
